intro: You need to catch a bus to the market. Ask the conductor for help.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Hello! Which bus are you looking for?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say where you want to go.
expected: I want to go to the market.
I am going to the market.
I need to go to the station.
conversation.hint: Try: "I want to go to the market."

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: The number twelve bus goes there. It comes in ten minutes.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask how much the ticket costs.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: It is twenty rupees. Please have the exact change ready.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Here is your ticket. Keep it safe.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask where you should get down.
expected: Which stop should I get down at?

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: The fourth stop. I will tell you when we reach it.
